title: 第23章 蛇杀术（求追读）
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
陈峰走出校门。

    他心中还在思索格斗术的事。

    格斗术，市面上倒也不是买不到。

    但市面上能买到的，基本上都是品质最差的格斗术。

    真正优秀的格斗术，为了避免外传，是不会给你课程视频和资料的，基本上都要老师手把手的教。

    而且，还非常的贵。

    动不动就是几十万……

    这显然不是陈峰能够买得起的。

    不过……

    陈峰脚步一顿，心中一动。

    他记得，之前从武馆中得到的那几本蛇脊流笔记，里面似乎就有格斗相关的内容。

    昨天他把那十本笔记全部上传，给太湖AI设置了分析任务。

    不知道现在完成了没有……

    陈峰随即收敛心思，加快脚步，朝青云小区赶去。

    ……

    出租屋。

    陈峰反锁房门，直奔电脑桌前坐下，打开太湖AI的个人数据库界面。

    果然。

    任务状态栏显示：分析完成。

    一份长达四十七页的整理报告，静静躺在数据库里。

    陈峰心中一喜，有些期待的点开报告，开始仔细翻看起来。

    开篇部分，是对笔记内容的一些总结。

    陈峰看了一会儿，随后发现，

    相比于现实武道的呼吸法门，这大墟世界的武道显得更加极端。

    现实世界的武道，中正平和，循序渐进。

    即便是以淬炼身躯作为重心的淬体境，

    其本质都只是调理肉身，把肉身视作容器或者基础，为后续的“内气”的强化而服务，有点像是“以武入道”。

    而大墟武道……至少从蛇脊流的体系来看，完全不走这条路。

    完全不养内气，只重气血与肉身。

    极端，暴烈，直接。

    而蛇脊流，便是一种以开阀法为根基，以密药为匙，强行打开人体的基因锁，用“开阀”的方式实现肉身素质的跨越式提升。

    更像是纯粹的“体修”。

    陈峰咂了咂嘴。

    随后继续向后翻去。

    而后续的内容，则开始变得零散起来。

    蛇息法、游鳞步、盘肘劲、蛇杀术……

    名字倒是列了不少，但大部分只有一个名称和寥寥几句描述，根本无法推断出完整的内容。

    而有些甚至连描述都没有，只是某个学员在笔记里提了一嘴，只有一个名字。

    陈峰一路看下来，心中越发失望起来。

    果然，大部分内容都是碎片。

    那些学员本身估计就没学全，笔记里自然也不可能记全。

    陈峰微微一叹，也不再抱什么期望，不过还是耐着性子，继续看下去。

    然后，直到翻到第三十九页的时候。

    陈峰视线微微一顿。

    报告中出现了几行文字。

    【《蛇杀术》完整度：97%】

    【该格斗术体系完整，招式明确，发力路径清晰。】

    【根据力学模型推演及同类武学数据库比对，该格斗术综合评级为：超越一级，上限二级。】

    陈峰盯着屏幕上这行字，目光猛地一亮。

    完整的！

    一门完整的，接近二级的格斗术！

    他猛地坐直身体，心跳微微加速。

    要知道，在现实世界，格斗术一般分为四个等级。

    基础、一级、二级和三级格斗术。

    一级格斗术，全套教学，老师指导，市面上的价格在十万到五十万之间。

    而二级格斗术，需要极为资深的拓脉境师傅长期指导，价格保底在百万起！

    往届大一省赛的擂台赛上，参赛选手们使用的大多数都是一级格斗术。

    只有极少数顶尖天骄，才有机会接触到二级的皮毛。

    而他手里这门蛇杀术，上限居然能比肩二级！

    陈峰心中狂喜，仔细回忆了一下，又打开笔记翻查了一会儿。

    他之前在刘氏武馆一楼的宣传墙上，好像确实看到过“蛇杀术”的名字。

    那是馆主刘长河的绝学，只有亲传弟子才有资格学习。

    而记录这门武学的那本笔记，字迹工整，内容详尽，每一式的名称、动作要领、发力路径、配合身法都写得清清楚楚。

    应该是刚被收为亲传弟子的学员，怕自己忘记，趁着印象新鲜的时候整理下来的。

    “真是柳暗花明……”

    陈峰目光热切，紧紧盯着电脑屏幕。

    他开始仔细研读起来。

    ……

    时间推移。

    一个小时后，夜色渐深。

    陈峰反复看了几遍蛇杀术的所有内容，基本已经读通了这门武学的原理。

    蛇杀术，核心宗旨八个字。

    “以身为蛇，以刃为牙。”

    武者的躯干、腰胯、脊椎，就如蛇一样游走、缠绕、扭转，每一次发力都从脊椎传导，以腰胯为轴心爆发。

    而手中的兵器，就是毒蛇的獠牙。

    一旦贴近敌人，以极短距离完成刺、挑、割、绞、斩等招式。
content_en:
Chen Feng walked out of the school gate.

He was still thinking about fighting skills in his mind.

Fighting skills are not unavailable on the market.

But what is available on the market is basically the lowest quality fighting skills.

For truly excellent martial arts, in order to avoid external rumors, we will not give you course videos and materials. Basically, you need to be taught by a teacher step by step.

Moreover, it is also very expensive.

It can easily cost hundreds of thousands...

This is obviously not something Chen Feng can afford.

But...

Chen Feng paused in his steps and felt something in his heart.

He remembered that the few snake spine notebooks he had obtained from the martial arts school seemed to contain fighting-related contents.

Yesterday, he uploaded all ten notebooks and set an analysis task for Taihu AI.

I don’t know if it’s finished now…

Chen Feng immediately gathered his thoughts, quickened his pace, and rushed towards Qingyun Community.

…

Rental house.

Chen Feng locked the door, went straight to the computer desk, sat down, and opened Taihu AI's personal database interface.

really.

The task status bar displays: Analysis completed.

A forty-seven-page collation report lies quietly in the database.

Chen Feng felt happy, clicked on the report with some anticipation, and began to look through it carefully.

The opening part is a summary of the contents of the notes.

Chen Feng looked at it for a while and then discovered,

Compared with the breathing method of real martial arts, the martial arts in this world are even more extreme.

Martial arts in the real world are neutral, peaceful, and gradual.

Even in the body tempering realm where tempering the body is the focus,

Its essence is just to condition the physical body, treating the physical body as a container or foundation to serve the subsequent strengthening of "inner Qi", which is a bit like "entering the Tao through martial arts".

As for Daxu Martial Arts... at least from the perspective of the Snake Ridge style system, it doesn't follow this path at all.

It does not nourish the inner Qi at all, but only focuses on the Qi, blood and physical body.

Extreme, violent, direct.

The Snake Ridge Flow is based on the valve-opening method and uses secret medicine as a key to forcibly open the genetic lock of the human body and use the "valve-opening" method to achieve a leap-forward improvement in physical quality.

It's more like pure "body training".

Chen Feng smacked his lips.

Then continue to turn back.

The subsequent content began to become fragmented.

Snake Breathing Technique, Swimming Scale Step, Cross-Elbow Strength, Snake Killing Technique...

There are quite a few names listed, but most of them only have one name and a few descriptions, making it impossible to deduce the complete content.

And some don't even have a description, just a student mentioned it in his notes, with only a name.

Chen Feng watched all the way and became more and more disappointed.

Sure enough, most of it was in fragments.

The students themselves probably didn't learn everything, so they certainly couldn't remember everything in their notes.

Chen Feng sighed slightly and no longer had any expectations, but he still had the patience to continue reading.

Then, until you turn to page 39.

Chen Feng's gaze paused slightly.

Several lines of text appeared in the report.

[Completeness of "Snake Killing Technique": 97%]

[This fighting technique system is complete, the moves are clear, and the path of exerting force is clear.】

[Based on mechanical model deduction and comparison with similar martial arts databases, the comprehensive rating of this fighting technique is: beyond level one, with an upper limit of level two.】

Chen Feng stared at the words on the screen and his eyes suddenly lit up.

Complete!

A complete, almost second-level fighting art!

He sat upright suddenly, his heartbeat speeding up slightly.

You know, in the real world, fighting skills are generally divided into four levels.

Basic, Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 martial arts.

First-level fighting skills, complete teaching, teacher guidance, the market price is between 100,000 and 500,000.

Second-level fighting skills require long-term guidance from extremely experienced masters in Tuomai Realm, and the price is guaranteed to start at one million!

In previous freshman provincial competitions, most of the contestants used first-level fighting techniques.

Only a handful of top geniuses have the opportunity to touch the surface of the second level.

And the snake-killing technique in his hand is actually as high as level two!

Chen Feng was ecstatic in his heart. He recalled it carefully, then opened his notes and looked through them for a while.

He seemed to have seen the name "Snake Killing Technique" on the promotional wall on the first floor of Liu's Martial Arts School before.

That is the unique skill of Liu Changhe, the master of the hall, and only his direct disciples are qualified to learn it.

The notebook that records this martial art is neatly written and detailed. The name of each move, the essentials of movements, the path of exerting force, and the corresponding body techniques are clearly written.

It was probably a student who had just been accepted as a direct disciple. He was afraid that he would forget it, so he compiled it while the impression was fresh.

"It's really a dark place..."

Chen Feng stared eagerly at the computer screen.

He began to study it carefully.

…

Time passes.

An hour later, the night grew darker.

Chen Feng read all the contents of Snake Killing Technique several times and basically understood the principles of this martial art.

The core purpose of the snake killing technique is eight words.

"Use your body as a snake and your blade as your teeth."

The warrior's torso, waist, and spine are like snakes swimming, entwining, and twisting. Every force exerted is transmitted from the spine and explodes with the waist and hips as the axis.

The weapon in his hand is the fang of a poisonous snake.

Once close to the enemy, he can perform stabbing, picking, cutting, strangulation, and beheading moves in a very short distance.
